exit.type: split position, 2 equal halves, same k70 stop (same total risk 1R)

half_A.note: = today's Assay exit: lock +0.25R once measured TP1 (f30/k) reached, H4 measured trail

half_B.note: free runner: no TP1 lock, stop to +0.05R after +1R, H4 h4q80 trail

exit.causal_alternative: monthly online chooser among {1200,1248,1254,1320,1324,50/50 1200+1320,50/50 1248+1320} by past per-signal Sharpe (mean/std of R of resolved signals): 35.1R, maxDD 1.5R, 14/19 months, eq_R2 0.882 (picked the 50/50 blend in 243/329 signals)

recommended_spec.entry_filter: none. Keep all signals (one position at a time). Every causal filter tested (S1 LGBM, pooled trend-slot LGBM, online feature-threshold rules, causal-percentile regime vetoes) reduced sumR and did not reduce maxDD.
inputs_needed_live: k70 = 0.7 quantile of recent MAE (already in Assay)
H4 closes + tw80 measured H4 pullback depth (already in Assay)
two tickets (or one ticket with partial close logic) per signal

in_sample_best.note: best single fixed policy by sumR/maxDD (in-sample). Max-sumR policy (k50, no lock, be1, h4q50, ts_half; idx 129) makes 78.3R but maxDD 6.2R, 11/19 months, top5days 101% - rejected as not smooth. Best 50/50 blend in-sample = the recommended one (ret_dd 28.2).

key_findings: The TP1 lock at +0.25R is what makes S1 smooth: every k70/k90 'slot'-lock variant has maxDD 1.1R and 14-17/19 positive months; removing it (k70, be1) raises sumR 26.6->43.9R but maxDD 1.1->2.0R and top5days 83%->92%.
Stop quantile k70 is the sweet spot: k50 lock variants have maxDD 4-5R and 10-13/19 months; k90 is smoother (16-17/19 months) but only 16-20R.

Splitting the position 50/50 (today's lock exit + a be1 free runner) gives 35.1R vs 26.6R (+32%) with maxDD 1.2R, ret/DD 28.2 vs 23.9, 15/19 months, same eq_R2 0.893; causal Sharpe chooser lands on the same blend (35.1R, DD 1.5R).
H4 trail depth (h4q80 vs h4q50 vs none), ratchets and time stop matter little; ATR chandelier trails (atr2/atr4) are clearly worse (7-24R, 9-12/19 months).

Entry: per-signal R is lower when the higher-TF trend is already stretched (d1_ret24, h4_z20, h1_adx, dist_prev_hi; Spearman -0.22..-0.30, same sign 5-7/7 quarters), but no filter helps the one-position book: the greedy slot already takes mainly the first signal of each pullback cluster (taken avg 0.58R vs 0.37R for the 283 blocked signals). Online ML IC ~0 (S1-only 0.02, pooled -0.05).

Losing/flat months (2025-05, 2025-10, 2026-02/03, 2026-07) are late/climactic trend phases (D1 ADX 36.6 vs 24.7 in good months, D1 ret48 7.3 vs 4.8 ATR) and the 2026 switch from longs to shorts; they cost only -0.8..-1.0R each; vetoes on d1_adx/d1_ret48/d1_atr_rank remove more good than bad trades.
robustness_notes: Blend neighbourhood: lock half in {1200,1208,1240,1248} x runner half be1 with h4q80 or no trail (1320/1352) at weights 0.3-0.7: 30-39R, maxDD 1.1-1.7R, ret/DD 21-28; runner with h4q50 trail or without be1 has DD 1.8-3.6R - keep be1 on the runner.

Gain is concentrated in strong trend months (2025-08, 2025-12, 2026-01 = +8.6R of the +8.5R); excluding Jan-2026 the blend still beats baseline 18.9R vs 16.0R. Month-by-month the blend is >= baseline in only 11/19 months; weeks positive 73% vs 80% (fewer tiny locked wins).
Only 329 S1 signals 2025+ and 38-48 taken trades; 9 losses in baseline. Every effect is statistically fragile; the recommendation is structural (fixed 50/50, no fitted threshold) to limit over-fit.
Causal regime-conditioned exit choice (online_best_policy with 14 regime features) did not beat the unconditioned choice consistently (36-48R, DD 2.0-2.7R).
Not tested in protocol scope: allowing a 2nd concurrent S1 position (blocked signals average +0.37R per signal under baseline exit) - would add correlated risk in the same trend.
